product: NISAR L2 GCOV PROVISIONAL (CRID P05023), frequency A, gamma0 HH/HV

rule.metric: Pearson r of 400 m HH dB images (4 x 4 blocks of the 100 m grid) between every pair of dates
rule.fail_if: median r of the date with all other dates < 0.5 while the median pairwise r among the remaining dates is >= 0.8 (leave-one-out; symmetric, no special case for first/last date)
rule.why: Permanent landscape structure (river channels, lakes, levees) cannot decorrelate across a 44 km scene within 12 days and then return; such a date indicates a processing, geolocation or propagation anomaly, not surface change. The rule uses spatial pattern only, never change magnitude.

compatibility.gap: No NISAR acquisition for the 2026-08-07 slot in the CMR snapshot (12-day cycle).
notes: All windows share EPSG, transform and coordinate vectors exactly (checked).
Orbit token 'F' (2026-07-14) marks a non-nominal (forecast/fast) orbit ephemeris; coregistration is checked by phase correlation instead of assumed.
2026-09-24 is a single-pol SHSH acquisition: HH only, excluded from every HV statistic.

rule.stable_wet: IGBP class in {10 Permanent Wetlands, 16 Water Bodies} in BOTH 2023 and 2024
rule.centreline: per cell-row median column of stable-wet pixels, gaps linearly interpolated, then running median over 5 cell rows
rule.side: margin cell is west if its centre column < centreline, else east

noise.interpretation: The independence-based SE is a LOWER bound (20 m GCOV samples are spatially correlated). The robust SD of consecutive-date differences is an UPPER bound on noise because it also contains real change. The 3 dB gate exceeds both by a wide margin.

association.note: n <= 10 dates: |rho| must exceed ~0.65 to be nominally significant; wind is NOT available (POWER request did not include WS2M/WS10M).
association.model_note: OLS with n = 9 (HH) / 8 (HV) dates and 3 parameters: descriptive only; SE assume independent residuals; point rain from one POWER grid cell (~0.5 deg) for the AOI.

rule.water_linked: DSWx-S1 (OW+IV) fraction range over matched dates >= 0.20 AND |Spearman rho(NISAR cell HH dB, DSWx OW+IV)| >= 0.70 (n = matched dates)
rule.vegetation_consistent: DSWx-S1 (OW+IV) range < 0.10 AND HV first->last change >= +1.0 dB raw AND >= +1.0 dB after common-mode removal AND (HV-HH) change >= +0.5 dB AND Theil-Sen HV slope > 0
rule.unresolved: everything else (includes cells without HV or DSWx variation)

criteria.a_structured_differential_change: a region's common-mode-removed first->last change (HH or HV) has a 95% block-bootstrap CI excluding 0 and |median| >= 0.5 dB
criteria.b_independent_association: cell-level NISAR HH vs DSWx-S1 water temporal association beats the date-permutation null at p < 0.05
criteria.c_persistent_area: persistent change (T = 3 dB, raw AND normalised) covers >= 1 % of the valid area
criteria.outcome: Sudd is INFORMATIVE if any of a/b/c holds, otherwise AMBIGUOUS -> run the same pipeline, unchanged, on the predefined alternatives (Okavango, Congo) before any interpretation

distance_profile.note: negative = west of the centreline; cells with >= 80 % stable savanna only (land-cover held constant); 95 % cell bootstrap CI

uncertainty_methods.regional_change_ci: 2x2 analysis-cell (~2.2 km) fixed-grid spatial block bootstrap, 2000 replicates
uncertainty_methods.temporal_association_null: 999 joint date permutations; preserves the spatial field within each date

delta_hh_first_last.render: HH change first->last, dB (-6 blue .. +6 red)

delta_hv_first_last.render: HV change first->last, dB (-6 blue .. +6 red)

trend_hh.render: HH OLS trend, dB per 30 days (-1.5 .. +1.5)

trend_hv.render: HV OLS trend, dB per 30 days (-1.5 .. +1.5)
